PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE1.core: Your Jupiter in the 1st house means where you grow and find meaning is inseparable from your immediate presence and self-expression. You expand through being yourself. The 1st house is how you show up, and your Jupiter here makes your capacity for growth visible in your presence. You learn through direct experience of yourself. Your optimism shows on your body. Your faith is in your own capacity. You find meaning through showing up fully. Growth is personal and immediate to your Jupiter. The challenge is ensuring that expansion serves genuine development rather than just inflating ego.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE1.behavioral: You grow through expressing yourself, find meaning in being visible, and expand by showing up boldly. When you're pursuing growth, it's through being more fully yourself. When you're looking for wisdom, you find it through your own experience. Your approach to expansion is direct and personal. You embody your own growth. This isn't narcissism. It's genuine faith in your capacity to expand through being. The shadow is that visibility can replace depth. You may perform growth without actually developing, or you may confuse confidence with wisdom. The work is ensuring that what you're showing is actually who you're becoming, not just what looks impressive.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE1.feed: Jupiter is moving through your 1st house. Your capacity for growth and finding meaning is focused on self-expression, immediate presence, and being visible right now. This is a time for expanding through showing up, for finding wisdom in your own experience, for trusting that your presence can teach.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE1.sonic: Your Jupiter in the 1st house contributes expansive melodic presence in the foreground, optimistic harmonic self-expression, and rhythm that is confident and visible. The quality of growth is immediate and personal, creating expansion through bold presence. Listen for music where wisdom arrives through being fully present and visible.

PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE2.core: Your Jupiter in the 2nd house means where you grow and find meaning is organized around resources, building value, and understanding what you actually have. You expand through accumulation. The 2nd house is material reality, and your Jupiter here makes your capacity for growth connected to creating tangible abundance. You learn through working with physical reality. Your optimism is about having enough. Your faith is in the earth's capacity to provide. You find meaning through building resources. Growth is material to your Jupiter. The challenge is ensuring that accumulation serves genuine security rather than just satisfying the desire for more.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE2.behavioral: You grow through building resources, find meaning in material abundance, and expand by creating tangible value. When you're pursuing growth, it's through accumulating wealth or developing skills that generate income. When you're looking for wisdom, you find it through working with what's physical. Your approach to expansion is grounded and practical. You trust that growth happens through building. This isn't greed. It's genuine faith in material abundance. The shadow is that accumulation can become the only goal. You may measure all growth by material success, or you may confuse having more with being more. The work is ensuring that what you're building actually serves your life rather than just proving you can accumulate.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE2.feed: Jupiter is moving through your 2nd house. Your capacity for growth and finding meaning is focused on resources, material abundance, and building value right now. This is a time for expanding through accumulation, for finding wisdom in working with physical reality, for trusting the earth's capacity to provide.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE2.sonic: Your Jupiter in the 2nd house contributes rich harmonic abundance, sustained melodic accumulation, and rhythm that builds steadily. The quality of growth is material and grounded, creating expansion through tangible building. Listen for music where wisdom arrives through working with physical resources and creating real value.

PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE3.core: Your Jupiter in the 3rd house means where you grow and find meaning is organized around communication, learning, and connecting ideas. You expand through curiosity. The 3rd house is immediate environment and mental activity, and your Jupiter here makes your capacity for growth connected to constant learning and sharing. You learn through conversation and reading. Your optimism is about understanding. Your faith is in ideas and communication. You find meaning through teaching and learning. Growth is mental and social to your Jupiter. The challenge is developing enough depth that breadth becomes expertise rather than just surface knowledge.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE3.behavioral: You grow through constant learning, find meaning in communication and ideas, and expand by making connections across subjects. When you're pursuing growth, it's through reading, talking, and exploring many topics. When you're looking for wisdom, you find it through conversation and intellectual exchange. Your approach to expansion is curious and social. You trust that growth happens through learning. This isn't scattered. It's genuine faith in curiosity. The shadow is that variety can prevent mastery. You may learn endlessly without applying anything, or you may confuse knowing about things with actually understanding them. The work is allowing yourself to go deep with one subject rather than staying perpetually on surfaces.

This is a time for expanding through curiosity, for finding wisdom in conversation, for trusting your mental agility.
PLCMT_JUPITER_HOUSE3.sonic: Your Jupiter in the 3rd house contributes quick melodic connections, bright harmonic exchanges, and rhythm that is conversational and nimble. The quality of growth is mental and social, creating expansion through communication. Listen for music where wisdom arrives through dialogue and the pleasure of ongoing discovery.
